subtasks.title: Add AfterUserCreateFunc type and hook field to apikit Server struct
details: In apikit package, add to a new file (e.g. apikit/hook.go): type AfterUserCreateFunc func(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, userID, username, email string) error
Add unexported field `afterUserCreate AfterUserCreateFunc` to the Server struct
Implement func (s *Server) OnAfterUserCreate(fn AfterUserCreateFunc) { s.afterUserCreate = fn }
Ensure the field is not exported; replace-on-call semantics (no mutex needed for single-goroutine setup)

subtasks.title: Wire hook into handleCallback OAuth new-user branch
details: In oauth/handleCallback (around line 182-226), after new user INSERT within the transaction, check if s.afterUserCreate != nil
If non-nil, call s.afterUserCreate(ctx, tx, userID, username, email)
If it returns a non-nil error, roll back the transaction and return HTTP 500
If no hook registered, proceed with commit as before (backward compatible)
Do not call hook in the returning-user branch (UPDATE path)

subtasks.title: Wrap createUser admin handler in transaction and wire hook
details: In handlers/createUser, begin a *sql.Tx before the user INSERT using db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
If Begin fails, return HTTP 500 immediately without INSERT or hook call
After successful user INSERT within tx, call s.afterUserCreate(ctx, tx, userID, username, email) if registered
If hook returns error, roll back and return HTTP 500; do not call os.Exit or panic
On success, commit tx and return HTTP 201

subtasks.title: Implement sanitizeSlug function in hub personal org hook package
details: Create hub/orgs/slug.go (or similar) with func sanitizeSlug(username, userID string) string
Step 1: strings.ToLower(username)
Step 2: replace non-[a-z0-9_-] chars with hyphens using regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-z0-9_-]`).ReplaceAllString
Step 3: collapse consecutive hyphens: regexp.MustCompile(`-{2,}`).ReplaceAllString(s, `-`)
Step 4: trim leading/trailing hyphens and underscores using strings.Trim(s, `-_`)
Step 5: if result starts with digit, prepend 'u-'
Step 6: if len(result) < 2, return 'u-' + userID[:8] as fallback

details: In hub/orgs/hook.go, after sanitizing the slug, query tx for: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orgs WHERE slug = ?

Use the *sql.Tx for all SELECT queries (not the raw db connection)
